newsitem.title: MEXICO: Hybrid conference attracts hundreds of scientists.
newsitem.headline: Hybrid conference attracts hundreds of scientists.

text.p: A conference on hybrid vigor here next month is seen attracting more than 400 seed scientists from around the world, organizers said.

The Mexico City conference will be held from Aug. 17-22. The hosting International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center said in a statement the conference is the latest on the topic in the past 47 years.

Hybrid vigor is the crossing of two very different plant varieties to produce a crop that yields more than either parent plant. The process has been applied in U.S. corn and vegetable crops and in Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America.
U.S. Nobel Peace Prize winner Norman Borlaug and Mexico's Agriculture Minister Francisco Labastida have been invited to inaugurate the week-long conference, the center said.
